sources.title: Abid Surti in conversation with Shai Heredia
sources.inspection: Fresh direct full interview; relevant lines30–66
claims: Surti recalls Pati meeting him at mirror-collage exhibition, proposing studio recreation of his painted room.
Surti resisted conventional biography, proposed artist born/creates/dies but art remains; Pati invited staff discussion, Surti recalls having veto over script ideas.
The team placed a door in the floor; imagined room arrangement changed with this choice.
Surti describes frame-by-frame pixilation and credits Vijay Raghav Rao with sound.
sources.ready_paraphrase: Abid Surti remembered the film beginning with a conversation about a room he had painted. Pati wanted him to recreate it at Films Division. Surti proposed a simple arc: an artist arrives, makes work and disappears, while the work remains. Staff discussed how to translate that into images; the door moved to the floor. This was a collaboration in which the painter helped shape the film, rather than merely appearing before the camera.
limits: Participant recollection, not witnessed by us. Do not invent dialogue or reconstructed scene.
Page dates Abid1970, FD lists1972. Use FD date with provenance or omit year in anecdote.
No need personal long-hours claims, celebrity visitors or universal no-bureaucracy assertion.

sources.title: Ram Mohan: Interview
sources.credit: Prof. Ravi Poovaiah, IDC IIT Bombay
sources.inspection: Fresh direct participant interview, lines154–156 chiefly
claims: Mohan recalls leadership encouraging experimentation, Pati seeking more graphic and stylised designs beyond dominant Disney influence.
Names puppets, object animation, cutouts and mixtures of live action and animation as possibilities Pati encouraged.
sources.ready_paraphrase: Animator Ram Mohan remembered Pati as someone who encouraged colleagues to try different materials and techniques. Animation could emerge from puppets, objects or cutouts as well as drawings. That account makes his contribution more than a list of films: he helped enlarge what other animators felt able to attempt.
limits: Site contains unrelated injected spam links; ignore entirely, relevant credited interview body remains.
Transcription has conflicting geography and garbled spellings; do not use its France/training chronology.
Mohan1966 move-out statement concerns cartoon unit, not departure from Films Division.
